name: kabo-alpha
description: Kabo — client for the creator-focused Skill distribution platform. Search, download, and verify the platform's creator data analysis skills (audience profiling, content ideation, revenue analysis, and more) inside Claude Code and run them in a restricted subagent. Authorization takes a single /mcp within the session; no Kabo token is stored on your machine. The third-party provider keys that creator research skills need are configured by you and run on your own accounts and quota.

youtube_api_key.title: YouTube Data API key
youtube_api_key.description: Used for YouTube public data retrieval (search, channels, videos, comments). Create one in the Google Cloud Console after enabling YouTube Data API v3. If left empty, the related skills report a missing dependency and stop; they will not substitute other data.

tubelab_api_key.title: TubeLab API key
tubelab_api_key.description: Used for account-relative outlier detection and channel video research. If left empty, the related skills report a missing dependency and stop.

scrapecreators_api_key.title: ScrapeCreators API key
scrapecreators_api_key.description: Needed for Instagram Reels reverse engineering and creator breakout boards. Billed per credit, on your own account. Also requires the scrapecreators CLI installed locally (npm i -g @scrapecreators/cli).

gemini_api_key.title: Google Gemini API key
gemini_api_key.description: Needed for video content analysis (hook/structure/CTA breakdown). Billed by usage, on your own account.
